_說明: THC6（Tree House C6）文法、聽力、發音與會話。cards＝課本 Grammar 頁小卡；questions＝文法題（choice 選擇、order 排句子）；listening＝用課本例句出的聽力題（lfill、lpick、lorder），加上發音聽辨（lpick、有 label）；phonics＝課本 Phonics 頁（例字用 [ ] 標出發這個音的字母）；talk＝課本 Conversation（會話站）。a＝正確選項位置（從 0 開始），App 會打亂選項順序。

U1.title: stop / keep Ving · Present Continuous · Adverbs of Degree
U1.zh: stop／keep 後面接 V-ing；現在進行式：現在正在做的事；程度副詞：really、very 讓副詞更強
rules: Becky and Susie will keep playing chess.
現在進行式：am / is / are ＋ V-ing
The dog is digging a hole.
否定：am not / isn't / aren't ＋ V-ing
Paul and Wally aren't having fun.
really / very ＋ 副詞：程度更強
Alice was throwing the balls really fast.
phrases: really fast　very carefully　very carelessly　really well　very slowly
mistakes: The dog is digging a hole.
形容動作要用副詞 carelessly

U1.q: Becky and Susie will keep ___ chess.
Please stop ___. I'm trying to read.
Tim kept ___ until he beat Paul.

U1.tip: 問句把 is 放前面；Kate＝she → Is

U1.q: Alice was throwing the balls really ___.
U1.tip: fast 的副詞還是 fast（沒有 fastly）
形容「怎麼溜」要用副詞：careless → carelessly

U1.say: Becky and Susie will keep playing chess.
U1.q: Becky and Susie will keep ___ chess.

U1.say: Paul and Wally aren't having fun.
Alice was throwing the balls really fast.
opts: Alice was throwing the balls really fast.
Alice was throwing the balls really slowly.
Alice is throwing the balls really fast.
U1.tip: 聽清楚 was（過去）和 fast
w 後面的 ar 唸 /ɔr/
label: 🔤 發音：選出你聽到的字 Which word did you hear?
Phonics: which word did you hear?
🔤 發音：選出你聽到的字 Which word did you hear?
Phonics: which word did you hear?

U1.tip: 字尾 ar 唸輕輕的 /ɚ/
label: 🔤 發音：選出你聽到的字 Which word did you hear?
Phonics: which word did you hear?

sounds.name: -ar-
sounds.rule: ar 在字中間或重音的地方唸 /ɑr/，嘴巴張大像「啊」再捲舌

sounds.name: w+ar-
sounds.rule: w 後面的 ar 不唸 /ɑr/，要唸 /ɔr/，像 or 的音

sounds.name: -ar
sounds.rule: 字尾不是重音的 ar 唸輕輕的 /ɚ/，跟 -er 一樣

U1.ex: stop 和 keep 後面接「動作」時，動作要加 -ing。stop＝不再做了；keep＝一直做下去。
eg: Susie 三點十五分停止溜冰。
Becky 和 Susie 會繼續下西洋棋。
Tim 一直努力到他贏為止。
U1.tip: 錯：stop skate／keep play → 對：stop skating／keep playing

U1.t: 現在進行式：現在「正在」做
U1.ex: 說「這一刻正在發生」的事。be 動詞跟著主詞變，動詞後面加 -ing。否定就在 be 動詞後面加 not。
eg: Paul 和 Wally 玩得不開心。
我正在試啊，但我沒辦法！
U1.tip: 動詞一定要加 -ing：is dig → is digging（dig 要重複 g）

U1.ex: 副詞告訴我們動作「怎麼做」：fast、carefully。前面再加 really 或 very，表示「非常」。
eg: Kate 溜冰溜得非常不小心。
我會試著更小心地溜冰。
U1.tip: 大部分形容詞加 -ly 變副詞（careful → carefully）；fast、hard 不變

lines: Paul
Get out of the way, Susie!
Susie，閃開！
Susie
I'm trying, but I can't!
我正在試啊，但我沒辦法！
Paul
Watch out!
小心！
Susie
AHHH!!!!
啊！
Paul
Now I lost the race. Why didn't you move?
這下我輸了比賽。妳為什麼不動？
Susie
You know I'm not very good at skating. Anyway, you were going too fast.
你知道我不太擅長溜冰的。總之，你溜得太快了。
Paul
Sorry, I really wanted to beat Tim.
對不起，我真的很想打敗 Tim。
Susie
You could have hurt me. This skating rink is for everyone, not just you and Tim.
你可能會傷到我耶。這個溜冰場是大家的，不是只有你和 Tim 可以用。
Paul
Yeah, you're right. I'll try to skate more carefully.
是，妳是對的。我會試著更小心地溜冰。
phrases: 叫別人讓路，很急的時候用（有點不客氣）
看到危險，馬上提醒別人
換個話題，或說出最重要的那句話
build: I really wanted to beat Tim.
I'll try to skate more carefully.

lines: Becky
Hey, Pam. What's going on?
嘿，Pam。怎麼回事？
Pam
I'm cleaning out my closet. A lot of my clothes are too small for me. Mom said that you should pick out the ones you like.
我正在清理衣櫥。很多衣服對我而言都太小了。媽媽說妳應該挑選一些妳喜歡的。
Becky
Really? You're going to give them to me?
真的嗎？妳要把它們給我？
Pam
If you want them.
如果妳要的話。
Becky
Sure. Wow, this dress looks really cute.
當然。哇，這件洋裝看起來真可愛。
Pam
Yeah, but there's a hole in the sleeve.
對啊，但袖子有一個破洞。
Becky
That's OK. My mom's good at sewing things.
沒關係。我媽媽很擅長縫紉。
Pam
It'll probably fit you. Try it on.
它可能會適合妳。試穿一下。
Pam
Becky, you look great! There's more in this pile for you to try. When you're finished, you can take the rest home to Kate.
Becky，妳看起來很漂亮！這疊還有更多衣服讓妳試穿。妳試穿完後，可以將其他的帶回家給 Kate。
Becky
Thanks, Pam! This is lots of fun!
Pam，謝謝妳！這好有趣！
phrases: 看到別人在忙，想知道發生什麼事
too ＋ 形容詞 ＋ for 某人
build: My mom's good at sewing things.

lines: Tim
Whew! Today must be the hottest day so far this summer.
唷！到目前為止今天一定是這個夏天最熱的一天。
Wally
Yeah, I'm thirsty already. Let's stop at that convenience store for a drink.
是啊，我已經口渴了。我們在那家便利商店停一下，喝點東西。
Tim
Good idea.
好主意。
Tim
I got an iced tea. What'd you get?
我拿了一瓶冰茶。你拿了什麼？
Wally
Milk tea, and this. It's a new candy bar.
奶茶和這個。這是新的糖果棒。
Wally
Aw, I don't have enough money. Can you lend me twenty dollars?
噢，我的錢不夠。你可以借我二十元嗎？
Tim
I don't know, Wally. You still owe me ten dollars from last week. You should pay me back before I lend any more money to you.
Wally，我不確定。上週你還欠我十元。你應該在我借更多錢給你之前先還我錢。
Wally
You're right. Here's your ten, then.
你是對的。既然這樣，你的十元。
Tim
Thanks.
謝謝。
Wally
You're welcome. Now, can I borrow thirty dollars?
不客氣。現在，我可以借三十元嗎？
build: Can you lend me twenty dollars?
You still owe me ten dollars.

lines: Alice
My king, there's a terrible red dragon above the castle!
國王，城堡上方有一隻可怕的紅色的龍！
Chuck
Quick! Tell my knights and archers! Get ready to attack!
快！告訴我的武士們和弓箭手！準備攻擊！
Chuck
Archers, raise your bows. Ready, attack!
弓箭手，舉高你們的弓。預備，攻擊！
Alice
Oh, Chuck! You messed up your lines again. You forgot to say, "Knights, draw your swords."
噢，Chuck！你又搞錯台詞了。你忘了說：「武士們，拔劍。」
Chuck
Sorry, acting is really hard.
對不起，演戲真難。
Alice
No, it's not. You didn't learn your lines well enough. Look at your script.
不，不難。你沒背熟台詞。看你的劇本。
Chuck
OK, OK. I'm ready now. Let's try again.
好，好。現在我準備好了。我們再試一次。
Chuck
Knights, raise your bows! Archers, draw your swords!
武士們，舉高你們的弓。弓箭手，拔劍！
Alice
No, Chuck! That's still wrong. Give me the crown! If you don't want to take this seriously, then I'll be the king.
不對，Chuck！那樣還是錯。王冠給我，如果你不認真排練，我就要演國王了。
phrases: 失敗了，鼓勵大家再來一次
叫別人不要隨便、要認真

lines: Jimmy
Becky. Becky! Stop watching TV. Will you play "Wizard's Fight" with Kate and me? Pleeeaaase?
Becky，Becky！不要看電視了。妳要跟我和 Kate 玩「巫師大戰」嗎？拜託？
Becky
Oh, all right. You two can team up against me.
噢，好吧。你們兩個可以組隊跟我對抗。
Jimmy
OK! I'll attack first! Take my fireball spell, Becky!
好！我先攻！Becky，接我的火球咒。
Becky
Ha, ha, ha! It won't work on me. I cast a water wall spell, and it will protect me from fire.
哈哈哈！對我沒效，我施了水牆咒，它會保護我不受火擊。
Kate
Water? How about this ice spell? It will freeze you in the water!
水？這冰咒如何？它會讓妳在水裡結成冰！
Becky
Silly little wizard. I have a magic mirror, and your spell bounced back. Now, you and Jimmy are both frozen.
傻小巫師。我有魔鏡，妳的咒語彈回去了。現在，妳和 Jimmy 都結凍了。
Jimmy
Hey! That's not fair! You can't just freeze us with a magic mirror!
嘿！不公平！妳不能用魔鏡冰凍我們。
Becky
You can't talk, you're both frozen. Now, I'm going to watch TV.
你們不能說話，你們兩個冰凍了。現在我要去看電視了。
phrases: 提出另一個辦法：How about this ice spell?
build: It will protect me from fire.

lines: Susie
Wow, there's a lot of neat stuff here in Grandpa's attic.
哇，爺爺的閣樓裡有好多好棒的東西喔。
Chuck
Yeah, check this out. It looks like a magic lamp. You know what happens when you rub a magic lamp, don't you?
對啊，妳看這個。看起來像神燈。妳知道擦一擦神燈會發生什麼事，對吧？
Susie
Of course, a genie will pop out and give you three wishes.
當然，一個精靈會蹦出來並給你三個願望。
Chuck
That's right! I'm going to rub it and make my dreams come true!
沒錯！我來把它擦一擦使我的願望實現！
Susie
I don't know, Chuck. Sometimes genies trick people. If your wishes are too good to be true, something bad might happen.
Chuck，我不知道。有時精靈會捉弄人。如果你的願望太過美好，可能會發生不好的事。
Chuck
Don't worry. I'll be careful when I choose my wishes. Here goes!
別擔心。選擇願望時我會小心。開始囉！
Susie
Chuck! Is that really a genie behind the dust?
Chuck！灰塵後的那個真的是一個精靈嗎？
Chuck
I . . . I . . . don't know. I'm not sure . . .
我…我…我不知道。我不確定…
Susie
That's not a genie! It's Grandpa!
那不是精靈！是爺爺！
Grandpa
What are you kids doing? You're supposed to be helping me clean!
你們這些孩子在做什麼？你們應該在幫我打掃！
phrases: 叫別人看你發現的東西
要做一件有點緊張的事之前說
提醒別人本來該做的事
build: It looks like a magic lamp.
I'll be careful when I choose my wishes.

lines: Tim
Hey! You can't cut in front of me. Get back in line.
嘿！你不能在我前面插隊。去後面排隊。
Bully
Oh, yeah? Who's going to make me? You?
哦，是嗎？誰敢要我排隊？你？
Tim
Well, no.
嗯，不是。
Bully
That's what I thought. Now, get out of my way, shrimp.
我想也是。現在，軟腳蝦，滾開。
Alice
Hey, don't shove him!
嘿，不要推他！
Bully
Who are you?
你是誰？
Alice
I'm his sister. Those are your parents over there, right? Well, you'd better apologize to my brother, or I'll tell them what you did.
我是他姊姊。在那裡的是你的父母，對吧？嗯，你最好向我弟弟道歉，否則我會告訴他們你做的事。
Bully
Please . . . don't . . . Hey, I'm sorry.
拜託…不要…嘿，對不起。
Tim
It's OK.
沒關係。
Alice
Now, get back in line, and don't do it again.
現在，回去排隊，不要再犯了。
phrases: 叫插隊的人回到隊伍裡
給警告：you had better ＋ 動詞
build: You can't cut in front of me.
You'd better apologize to my brother.

lines: Wally
Hi, Pam. What are you reading?
嗨，Pam。你在看什麼書？
Pam
A book about riddles and puzzles.
一本關於謎語和猜謎的書。
Wally
Cool, I love riddles. Give me one.
酷，我喜歡謎語。考我一題。
Pam
Sure. Here's an easy one. How many months have 28 days in them?
好呀。先來一題簡單的。有多少個月份有二十八天？
Wally
That's a piece of cake! Only February has 28 days in it.
真簡單！只有二月有二十八天。
Pam
Sorry, you're wrong! All 12 months have 28 days in them.
抱歉，你答錯了！十二個月全都有二十八天。
Wally
That was a trick question. Give me another one. I'll get this one right for sure.
那題很詐。再問我一題。這次我肯定會答對。
Pam
OK. Listen carefully. Mary's father has four children. Three are named Jan, Jen, and Jin. What is the fourth child's name?
好，仔細聽喔。Mary 的爸爸有四個小孩，有三個名字是 Jan、Jen 和 Jin。第四個小孩叫什麼名字？
Wally
Let's see . . . a, e, i . . . Jon. The fourth child must be Jon!
我想想… a、e、i… Jon。第四個小孩一定是 Jon！
Pam
Nope, wrong again. It's Mary.
不對，又錯了。答案是 Mary。
Wally
Ah! That was a tricky one. Give me another one.
噢！那題很詐。再問我一題。
phrases: 想答案的時候先說這句

lines: Paul
Hey, Wally. What did you get Chuck for his birthday?
嘿，Wally。你送 Chuck 什麼生日禮物？
Wally
I heard that he's interested in reptiles, so I got him a DVD about poisonous snakes. How about you?
我聽說他對爬蟲類有興趣，所以我買一片有關毒蛇的 DVD 要給他。你呢？
Paul
A model robot. See? You get to put it together yourself.
一個模型機器人。你看？你要自己組裝。
Wally
Cool. It says here you can paint it, too!
酷。這裡說你也可以將它塗上顏色。
Paul
Paint? Uh-oh, I didn't buy any paint. I sure hope he already has some.
塗顏色？糟糕，我沒有買任何顏料。我希望他已經有些顏料了。
Wally
Don't worry. If he doesn't have any, he can go buy some himself.
別擔心。如果他沒有，他可以自己去買一些。
Paul
I guess so. I just don't want him to hate my gift!
我想是吧。我只是不要他討厭我的禮物！
Wally
Relax. It's an awesome gift. I would love it if I were him.
放輕鬆。這是個很棒的禮物。如果我是他，我會愛死它。
phrases: 假設不可能的事，用 were
build: What did you get Chuck for his birthday?
He can go buy some himself.
I would love it if I were him.
